entry.title: Motion to remove Luke Dashjr from BIP Editors
entry.summary: In a recent update from the Bitcoin Development Mailing List, it has been announced that Luke Dashjr is no longer a permissioned user on the BIP content repository. This information was conveyed by Bryan, and further details can be accessed through [Bryan's update](https://x.com/kanzure). This change may impact the management or operations within the BIP content repository, as Luke Dashjr has been known to be an active participant in this community. The reasons for this decision have not been disclosed in the message.
